video_title: “I Take Pride In Being Aggressive.” | Ayo Dosunmu Postgame Sound | 11.2.26

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the team's mindset regarding winning
quotes.excerpt: not feeling obligated or entitled for a win just because the team's record
quotes.quote: I think the main thing is just being in the moment, not thinking too far ahead and not feeling obligated or entitled for a win just because the team's record. It's the NBA, the best players in the world, so each and every game you have to go out there and take it. No team is going to just lay down and allow you to take a victory.
quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu on the team mindset: You cannot feel entitled to a win just because of a record. It is the NBA, the best players in the world, so each and every game you have to go out there and take it.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu discusses the team's mindset and the necessity of earning wins in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on Trey Murphy III's impact and veteran presence
quotes.excerpt: he's just a veteran in this league, so him being out there, he understands what's needed
quotes.quote: He's just a veteran in this league, so him being out there, he understands what's needed at what time. His offensive rebounding and combining that with his ability to stretch the floor has been great for us. He gave us a big spark, a big three, a big turnaround jump shot, and I think that's something that you need.
quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu praises Trey Murphy III for his veteran impact, noting his offensive rebounding and ability to stretch the floor provided a big spark for the team.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu praises Trey Murphy III for his veteran presence and contributions to the team.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the growth and competitiveness of Johan
quotes.excerpt: he has that it factor in terms of he wants to be the best
quotes.quote: Johan continues to learn, he continues to want to get better. I think he has that it factor in terms of he wants to be the best. He holds himself accountable and so I love that about him. He learns quick, watching film with him or just seeing him watch film with his coaching staff, he's able to incorporate that in the game at a fast rate.
quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu says Johan has the it factor and is learning quickly, noting that he holds himself accountable and is able to incorporate film study into his game at a fast rate.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu comments on the growth and work ethic of his teammate Johan.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the team's halftime message regarding competitiveness
quotes.excerpt: we understand that we should win this game, but at the same time, we have to go take it
quotes.quote: I told the guys that we were up one point, but I think Tyler Herro came down and made two threes, so we were up seven. It was one point in the first half, I think we went up maybe 10 or 11. We had them on the ropes, but they're an NBA team and they made some shots and that's okay. I told them at halftime, look, I understand that it may not be right or wrong, but we understand that we should win this game, but at the same time, we have to go take it. They're not going to just lay down and say, okay, here you go, Minnesota Timberwolves, here go a win.
quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu on the halftime message: We had them on the ropes, but they are an NBA team and they made some shots. We understand that we should win this game, but we have to go take it.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu reflects on the team's halftime message regarding maintaining intensity against Tyler Herro and the opponent.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the importance of staying out of foul trouble
quotes.excerpt: the more he can stay on the court, the more valuable he is for our team
quotes.quote: I just tell him, stop fouling. At some point, he learns and he's a competitor also, so he wants to be out there. He's one of the best competitors that I've been around, so the more he can stay on the court, the more valuable he is for our team. We need him on the court, we don't need him in foul trouble, so he understands that.
quotes.social_post: Ayo Dosunmu on the importance of staying out of foul trouble: We need him on the court, we do not need him in foul trouble, so he understands that.

structured.context: Ayo Dosunmu explains the importance of a teammate staying out of foul trouble to remain valuable on the court.
